title: Vault agent daemon — in-memory credential server via Unix socket
description: Create src/security/vault_agent.py. Systemd user service. On start: prompts for passphrase (getpass), reads salt from vault.salt, derives key via wolfcrypt PBKDF2 (600k iters), decrypts vault.enc (AES-256-GCM), loads credentials dict into memory. Zeroes passphrase bytes after derivation. Listens on /run/fx-vault-agent.sock (mode 600). JSON protocol: {action: 'get', name: '...'} -> {ok: true, value: '...'} or {action: 'list'} -> {ok: true, names: [...]}. Peer credential check: only same UID can connect (SO_PEERCRED). On SIGTERM: zero credential memory. Exits on decryption failure (wrong passphrase), user retries.
acceptance_criteria: Agent starts, serves credentials via socket, wrong-UID client rejected, SIGTERM zeros memory
